records.source_title: Laws of the Game 2026/27 (English, single pages)
records.reviewed_statement: Law 7.1 establishes the standard scheduled 90 regulation minutes (2 x 45), excluding interval, extra time and shoot-outs. Reduction requires prior referee/team agreement and competition-rule permission. Added time and penalty completion can extend play; abandonment can prevent completion. This is not a guarantee of any individual match duration. Local TEST decision window only: from this review until 2026-09-26T00:00:00Z; conservative next-UTC-day re-review cap, NOT an official expiry. Official edition is already in force. No historical or next-season validity asserted.

records.source_title: Regulations of the UEFA Champions League 2026/27
records.reviewed_statement: Article 13.01 incorporates IFAB Laws; it does not itself state 90 minutes. Article 1.01 covers the 2026/27 competition including qualifying and play-offs. Article 96.01: adopted 11 February, effective 1 March 2026; amendments effective 20 May and 29 July 2026. Scope is the standard scheduled format, with IFAB qualifications preserved.
